purpose: Disambiguate physical provenance restrictions from replay-consumption restrictions after the fail-closed BT-GATE-014 V0.4 probe.

physical_provenance_restriction_codes.meaning: Canonical restrictions inherited from candidate construction, scientific design, source lineage, materialization and promotion status.
physical_provenance_restriction_codes.consumer_treatment: Preserve losslessly as audit lineage. Do not reinterpret automatically as EventLoop policy or execution authority.
physical_provenance_restriction_codes.comparison: Exact canonical equality is required only against the physical row value whose fingerprint is being verified.

replay_consumption_restriction_codes.source: bounded selection manifest, bundle restrictions and sidecar row restriction_codes
replay_consumption_restriction_codes.meaning: Operational limitations governing whether and how the bounded state may be delivered to a consumer.
replay_consumption_restriction_codes.authority: bounded provider/shared-boundary authorization and replay sidecar
replay_consumption_restriction_codes.comparison: Canonical set equality is required between the authorized bounded set and the sidecar row set for this probe.

component_replay_restriction_codes.meaning: Replay-legality limitations contributed by each required core-four component.
component_replay_restriction_codes.comparison: Every component set must be a subset of the row replay-consumption set; the row set must include the union of all component sets.

binding_rules: physical_provenance_restriction_codes and replay_consumption_restriction_codes are distinct non-substitutable domains
physical row restriction_codes_json must remain fingerprinted and preserved byte-reproducibly
physical provenance codes must survive into audit lineage without loss
replay-consumption codes govern delivery legality and consumer policy checks
component replay codes must propagate into the row replay-consumption domain
no equality comparison is permitted between physical provenance codes and replay-consumption codes
no physical provenance code may grant production, downstream, official-dataset, strategy, order, fill or execution authority
no replay-consumption code may erase or rewrite physical provenance lineage
a combined display or audit projection may expose both domains but must retain domain labels
an unlabeled union must not be used as the executable restriction policy

consumer_projection.store_requirement: MarketStateStore must preserve both labeled domains without using provenance codes as execution policy
fail_closed_conditions: physical raw restrictions cannot reproduce the physical fingerprint
component replay restriction not propagated to row replay restrictions
domain label absent or domains silently merged
consumer treats provenance restriction as production or execution permission

next_owner.required_action: Adopt this binding in the consumer contract, event, audit lineage, store and regression suite before proposing a new single-use authorization.
